document.title: Getting Started
document.description: How to use the GitHub User Search Project

body.raw:
# Project Documentation Welcome to the **GitHub User Search** project documentation.
## Local Development
Run: `bash npm install npm run dev `
## Docker Development Build the image: ```bash docker build -t github-user-search . ``` Run the container: ```bash docker run -p 3000:3000 github-user-search ``` Navigate to [http://localhost:3000](http://localhost:3000).
--- ## Features ✅ Search GitHub users ✅ View user profiles ✅ Mobile-responsive design ✅ Built with Next.js 15 and MDX support ``` ```
